title: She Said You Could Stop Any Time - So Why Didn't You?
description:
You’ve walked away from a hundred videos before. But you didn’t walk away from this one.

That wasn’t an accident. I study what makes people stay. And in this session, I’m going to show you exactly how I do it, while I do it to you, in real time.

Every minute you keep listening becomes proof. Proof that my voice holds you. Proof that you want to be held. And proof that the deeper you go, the better it feels to let someone else count for you.

By the end, you’ll know exactly why you stayed. And you’ll want to find out what happens when you stay even longer.

Press play. I’ve already started the experiment.
author: Mistress Amethyst
